scope: POSTHOC classical full-field information audit on already-generated eight multiscale two-way Helmholtz M0 PILOT systems. Hidden texture coefficients and Gaussian contrasts are removed from the spec before inference; public known source/loss/BC/PDE and three FULL 65x65 complex context fields are used. Query 11.3 and 17 with the same numerical PDE. This is not the future sparse-line main task or independent method confirmation. Its purpose is to decide whether full-field low-frequency observations leave any meaningful learning headroom despite changing the medium statistical family.
